team_0.color: Navy blue shirts, navy blue shorts, dark socks

team_1.color: White shirts with black shoulders, black shorts, white socks

plays.summary: White advances down the far touchline and sends a ball into the navy penalty area before navy defends and wins possession.

players.note: Reads the danger at the edge of the box well; next time scan earlier to pick out a forward outlet before clearing.
Moved the ball down the flank effectively, though checking inside for a support pass could open a better shooting angle.
Attempted to get a shot off in traffic; take a cleaner first touch away from the defender to create space.

plays.summary: Navy launches a counter-attack with a long through ball down the right channel, forcing the white goalkeeper to rush out and make a crucial intervention at the edge of the box.

players.note: Vision and weighted long through ball reminiscent of Kevin De Bruyne.
Great burst of pace to latch onto the pass; try to lift the finish earlier before the goalkeeper closes the angle.
Got caught square by the ball over the top; drop a yard earlier when the opponent has time on the ball.
Decisive sweeper-keeper timing off the line reminiscent of Manuel Neuer.

plays.summary: The white goalkeeper restarts play from the back and passes out toward the left flank, where the ball goes out of play on the far touchline.

players.note: Applied steady pressure on the touchline to force the ball out; keep angling the run to cut off the line pass.
Chose a safe outlet to the wide defender; look to play with slightly more pace so the receiver has time to turn.
The forward pass along the touchline drifted out; open your body earlier to see midfield options.

plays.summary: White takes a throw-in on the far side, gets pressed high by navy, and recycles possession back through their goalkeeper to switch play.

players.note: Good work rate to press the back line and force the back-pass; curve your run to trap them on one side.
Composure under pressure to keep possession alive and recycle safely.
Smart choice to use the goalkeeper under pressure; play the back-pass slightly wider of the goal frame next time.
Clean first-time distribution out to the opposite flank to beat the press.

plays.summary: White strings together neat passes from the far touchline into central midfield before navy steps in to win possession.

players.note: Anticipated the central pass well to break up white's rhythm.
Crisp combination play down the touchline to beat the first line of pressure.
Good movement to receive between the lines, though the final pass was telegraphed into the defender.

plays.summary: Navy wins the ball in midfield and looks to break forward, but the white centre-back reads the pass and intercepts cleanly.

players.note: Attempted a direct forward pass into a crowded area; look wide to release a winger in space.
Front-foot reading of the pass and clean recovery reminiscent of Virgil van Dijk.

plays.summary: White plays a long ball over halfway, wins the second ball, and drives forward before a navy defender commits a foul for a free kick.

players.note: Stepped in too aggressively and gave away a foul in a dangerous area; stay on your feet and delay the attacker.
Effective long ball to bypass midfield and relieve pressure.
Strong hold-up and forward drive to draw the foul inside navy's half.

plays.summary: White delivers a long free kick into the navy penalty area, creating a scramble before navy clears the danger and regains control.

players.note: Attacked the first bounce decisively to clear the box and start a transition.
Driven set-piece delivery into a dangerous zone; aim slightly closer to the back post for runners.

plays.summary: Navy builds out from the back through midfield and launches a long ball forward that white's back line intercepts.

players.note: Moved play out of the defensive third, though keeping the ball on the ground through the wide channels was available.
Tracked the flight of the ball well and cleared cleanly to midfield.

plays.summary: Navy battles to retain possession in midfield before their central midfielder beats pressure and threads a lofted through ball down the right channel.

players.note: Press-resistant turn and incisive lofted through ball reminiscent of Luka Modric.
Timed the diagonal run well to chase the ball into the corner; try to cut inside earlier before the defender recovers.
Strong recovery sprint and body positioning to shield the winger and force the ball out of play.

plays.summary: Play stops briefly while players reset and an extra ball is cleared off the field ahead of a throw-in on the near right touchline.
White breaks down the near left flank from a throw-in and drives a dangerous ball into the box, where navy's defender makes a vital high clearance.

players.note: Got beaten on the outside off the throw-in; stay goal-side and force the winger toward the touchline.
Last-ditch block inside the penalty area reminiscent of Ruben Dias.
Explosive acceleration down the touchline to beat his marker reminiscent of Vinicius Junior.
Good forward run into the box to deliver the cross; clip it toward the penalty spot to avoid the near defender.

plays.summary: Navy attempts to play out from the clearance along the near touchline, but white presses tightly and forces the ball out for a throw-in.

players.note: Battled to keep possession in a tight corridor; play a quick first-time pass inside when pinned on the line.
Held onto the ball too long near the touchline; release it earlier before the double team arrives.
Relentless touchline pressing to trap navy and win the throw-in.

plays.summary: Play pauses as white's number 11 sets up to take a throw-in on the near touchline while both teams organize.
White's number 11 launches a long throw-in toward the attacking left side, where the aerial duel ends in a defensive free kick for navy.

players.note: Stood strong in the aerial contest off the throw-in to draw the foul and relieve pressure.
Delivered good distance on the throw-in, though a shorter throw to feet could have retained possession.

plays.summary: Navy takes the free kick from deep in their own half, sending a long accurate pass over midfield into the attacking half.

players.note: Pinpoint long-range distribution from the back reminiscent of Toni Kroos.
Misjudged the flight of the long free kick; drop back earlier to track runners behind.

plays.summary: Navy's attacking midfielder threads an assist into the right channel for the striker, who dribbles into the box and finishes cleanly past the goalkeeper for a goal.

players.note: Composed control and perfectly weighted through ball reminiscent of Mesut Ozil.
Sharp diagonal run, tidy touch past the defender, and clinical finish reminiscent of Karim Benzema.
Left too much space behind on the right channel; communicate with your full-back to track the striker's inside run.
Tried to narrow the angle late on the breakaway; hold your set position a fraction longer to react to the shot.

plays.summary: Both teams walk back to halfway following the goal and set up for white's kickoff as the clip ends.
